note: First verdict 2026-11-20 by an independent agent, after the annotation was re-homed to plan/post-release/kernel/spec-xfrm-outer-df-set-dscp.md (which lists this row); no tagged unit changed. RFC 4301 Section 8.1: "This means that it MUST be possible to configure the implementation's treatment of the DF bit (set, clear, copy from inner header) for each SA." Tested: "clear, copy from inner header". Gap: "set". Producer: internal/component/ike/dataplane/xfrm_linux.go::xfrmDFFlag and internal/component/ike/dataplane/vpp.go::vppDFError. Positives: df-bit parses per peer with absent as copy (TestDFBitIsConfigurablePerPeer); the engine hands the outbound SA the peer's treatment and the inbound copy, exactly one of each (TestDFBitTreatmentReachesTheBackend), and rekey keeps it (TestRekeyKeepsTheOuterHeaderTreatment); XFRM sets NoPMTUDisc for clear and not for copy (TestXFRMStateCarriesTheDFTreatment); VPP sends ENCAP_COPY_DF for copy and neither DF flag for clear (TestVPPInstallSACarriesTheDFTreatment); on the wire clear emits a clear outer DF for a set inner bit and copy follows the inner bit (TestXFRMOuterHeaderCarriesTheDFTreatment). Negatives: set, and a treatment on a transport, inbound or IPv6-outer SA, are refused with ErrSAOptionRefused on XFRM and VPP with nothing installed or sent (TestXFRMStateRefusesDFItCannotExpress, TestVPPInstallSARefusesDFItCannotExpress), and ValidateOuterHeader refuses set and an inapplicable clear (TestDFBitValidation). The scoped claim holds; DF set is refused, never installed as another treatment, and stays unmet.
